251: # Private controller-only admission custody. No child or constructor authority.
252: from snapshot_lifecycle import _NativePermit, Phase
253: from durable_lifecycle import DurableSnapshotLifecycle, _DurableLease
254: from snapshot_reservations import Reservation
255: 
256: 
257: _STARTUP_RESOLVER = resolver
258: _STARTUP_LOAD = resolver.load_manifest
259: _STARTUP_ADMIT = resolver.admit_snapshot
260: _STARTUP_BIND = resolver.bind_for_constructor
261: _STARTUP_RELEASE = _release
262: _STARTUP_PROFILE = _runtime_profile
263: _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS = {}
264: _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS = {}
265: 
266: 
267: @dataclass(frozen=True, eq=False)
268: class _ControllerASRStart:
269:     release: ReleaseAuthority
270:     approval: resolver.ManifestApproval
271:     manifest: resolver.TrustedManifest
272:     admission: resolver.Admission
273:     selected: resolver.Model
274:     policy: RuntimeProfile
275:     usage: str
276:     binding: resolver.LocalBinding
277:     permit: _NativePermit

280: class _StartupCustody:
281:     def __init__(self, release, manifest, selected, profile, usage, manager, factory):
282:         self.release, self.manifest, self.selected = release, manifest, selected
283:         self.profile, self.usage, self.manager, self.factory = profile, usage, manager, factory
284:         self.lease = self.admission = self.binding = self.permit = self.startup = None
285:         self.record = self.protection = self.token = self.key = None
286:         self.active = True
287:         self.consumed_by = None
288:         self.primary_error = None
289:         self.references = self.values = None
290:         self.initial_references, self.initial_values = _startup_authority_snapshot(self)
291: 
292: 
293: def _startup_configuration():
294:     # Verify the configured trust root before using even the pure resolver.
295:     _require(resolver is _STARTUP_RESOLVER
296:              and resolver.load_manifest is _STARTUP_LOAD
297:              and resolver.admit_snapshot is _STARTUP_ADMIT
298:              and resolver.bind_for_constructor is _STARTUP_BIND,
299:              "Fixed startup resolver required")
300:     authority = RELEASE_AUTHORITY
301:     _require(type(authority) is ReleaseAuthority
302:              and type(resolver.REAL_APPROVAL) is resolver.ManifestApproval
303:              and authority.manifest_approval is resolver.REAL_APPROVAL
304:              and resolver.REAL_APPROVAL.purpose == "real",
305:              "Accepted real startup approval is unavailable")
306:     return authority
307: 
308: 
309: def _startup_authority_snapshot(custody):
310:     a, m, p = custody.release, custody.manifest, custody.profile
311:     refs = (a, a.manifest_approval, a.manifest_bytes, m, m.models, *m.models,
312:             *(asset for model in m.models for asset in model.assets), p)
313:     values = (a.manifest_bytes, a.data_root, a.runtime_profile_id,
314:         a.manifest_approval.purpose, a.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256, m.raw,
315:         tuple((model.choice, model.repo, model.revision,
316:             tuple((asset.name, asset.size, asset.sha256) for asset in model.assets))
317:             for model in m.models), p.profile_id, p.device, p.compute_type,
318:         p.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract, p.capture_vad_contract, custody.usage)
319:     return refs, values
320: 
321: 
322: def _startup_selection_current(custody):
323:     _require(_startup_configuration() is custody.release
324:              and RUNTIME_PROFILE is custody.profile
325:              and SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE is custody.manager and RUNTIME_FACTORY is custody.factory
326:              and custody.factory.manager is custody.manager,
327:              "Configured startup authority changed")
328:     refs, values = _startup_authority_snapshot(custody)
329:     _require(len(refs) == len(custody.initial_references)
330:              and all(a is b for a, b in zip(refs, custody.initial_references))
331:              and values == custody.initial_values,
332:              "Configured startup values changed")
333:     _require(_STARTUP_PROFILE(custody.release, custody.usage) is custody.profile,
334:              "Current startup policy required")
335: 
336: 
337: def _startup_values(custody):
338:     # Bounded immutable scalar snapshots detect mutation of retained records;
339:     # matching these values alone never registers another startup object.
340:     a, m, d, p, b = (custody.release, custody.manifest, custody.admission,
341:                      custody.profile, custody.binding)
342:     manifest_values = tuple((model.choice, model.repo, model.revision,
343:         tuple((asset.name, asset.size, asset.sha256) for asset in model.assets))
344:         for model in m.models)
345:     return (a.manifest_bytes, a.data_root, a.runtime_profile_id,
346:         a.manifest_approval.purpose, a.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
347:         m.raw, manifest_values, d.manifest.raw,
348:         tuple((model.choice, model.repo, model.revision,
349:             tuple((asset.name, asset.size, asset.sha256) for asset in model.assets))
350:             for model in d.manifest.models),
351:         d.choice, d.private_root, d.snapshot, d.directory_identity,
352:         tuple((f.name, f.size, f.sha256, f.identity, f.handle_identity) for f in d.files),
353:         p.profile_id, p.device, p.compute_type, p.whisperx_fixed_vad_contract,
354:         p.capture_vad_contract, custody.usage,
355:         b.model_path, b.choice, b.revision, b.manifest_sha256,
356:         tuple((f.name, f.size, f.sha256, f.identity, f.handle_identity) for f in b.files),
357:         b.local_files_only, b.constructor_called, b.real_runtime_approved,
358:         custody.key.store_root, custody.key.choice, custody.key.revision,
359:         custody.token.generation, custody.token.physical.volume, custody.token.physical.file_id,
360:         custody.token.semantic.store_volume, custody.token.semantic.store_file_id,
361:         custody.token.semantic.choice, custody.token.semantic.revision, custody.token.semantic.manifest)
362: 
363: 
364: def _startup_references(custody):
365:     a, m, d = custody.release, custody.manifest, custody.admission
366:     return (a, a.manifest_approval, a.manifest_bytes, m, m.models,
367:         *m.models, *(asset for model in m.models for asset in model.assets),
368:         custody.selected, d, d.manifest, d.manifest.models, *d.manifest.models,
369:         *(asset for model in d.manifest.models for asset in model.assets),
370:         d.files, *d.files, custody.profile, custody.binding,
371:         custody.binding.files, *custody.binding.files,
372:         custody.permit, custody.permit.identity, custody.permit.manager, custody.permit.record,
373:         custody.record, custody.key, custody.protection, custody.token,
374:         custody.token.physical, custody.token.semantic, custody.token.gate,
375:         custody.token.service, custody.lease.binding)

377: 
378: def _validate_startup_locked(custody, startup, permit, session):
379:     manager, record, token = custody.manager, custody.record, custody.token
380:     _require(custody.active and custody.startup is startup
381:              and _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup)) is custody,
382:              "Exact live issued controller startup required")
383:     _startup_selection_current(custody)
384:     current = _startup_references(custody)
385:     _require(len(current) == len(custody.references)
386:              and all(a is b for a, b in zip(current, custody.references))
387:              and _startup_values(custody) == custody.values,
388:              "Retained startup selection changed")
389:     _require(custody.admission.manifest == custody.manifest
390:              and custody.admission.manifest.approval is custody.release.manifest_approval
391:              and custody.selected is next(model for model in custody.admission.manifest.models
392:                  if model.choice == custody.admission.choice)
393:              and custody.selected == next(model for model in custody.manifest.models
394:                  if model.choice == custody.admission.choice),
395:              "Admission model differs from approved selection")
396:     _require((startup.release is custody.release and startup.approval is custody.release.manifest_approval
397:               and startup.manifest is custody.manifest and startup.admission is custody.admission
398:               and startup.selected is custody.selected and startup.policy is custody.profile
399:               and startup.usage == custody.usage and startup.binding is custody.binding
400:               and startup.permit is custody.permit), "Startup record was replaced or changed")
401:     _require(type(permit) is _NativePermit and permit is custody.permit
402:              and permit.manager is manager and permit.record is record
403:              and record.key is custody.key
404:              and manager._records.get(record.key) is record and record.permit is permit.identity
405:              and record.protection is custody.protection
406:              and record.phase is Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED
407:              and not custody.lease.inner._exited and not custody.lease._finalization_started,
408:              "Current startup lease permit required")
409:     _require(type(token) is Reservation and custody.lease.token is token
410:              and manager._tokens.get(record.key) is token
411:              and token.service is manager._reservations
412:              and token.service._live.get(token.gate) is token
413:              and token.phase == "RESERVED" and token.pending is None
414:              and token.persistence_failure is None and token.revoked is False
415:              and token.worker is None and not token.resume_attempted,
416:              "Current unused durable startup reservation required")
417:     _require(record.key.store_root == custody.admission.private_root
418:              and record.key.choice == custody.admission.choice == custody.selected.choice
419:              and record.key.revision == custody.selected.revision
420:              and token.physical is custody.lease.binding[0]
421:              and token.semantic is custody.lease.binding[1]
422:              and token.generation == custody.lease.binding[2], "Exact reserved startup selection required")
423:     _require(token.semantic.choice == custody.selected.choice
424:              and token.semantic.revision == custody.selected.revision
425:              and token.semantic.manifest == custody.release.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256,
426:              "Durable selection differs from approved startup")
427:     if session is None:
428:         _require(record.owner is None and custody.consumed_by is None,
429:                  "Unconsumed pre-worker startup required")
430:     else:
431:         _require(type(session) is OwnedSession and record.owner is session
432:                  and session._record is record and session._manager is manager
433:                  and session._worker is None and not session._revoked and not session._closing
434:                  and session._active == 0 and not session._closed_verified
435:                  and (custody.consumed_by is None or custody.consumed_by is session),
436:                  "Exact live pre-worker session required")
437: 
438: 
439: def _validate_controller_startup(startup, permit, session=None):
440:     _require(type(startup) is _ControllerASRStart, "Issued controller startup required")
441:     custody = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
442:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody.startup is startup,
443:              "Copied controller startup has no issuance authority")
444:     with custody.manager._lock:
445:         with custody.token._lock:
446:             _validate_startup_locked(custody, startup, permit, session)
447:     return startup
448: 
449: 
450: def _consume_controller_startup(startup, permit, session):
451:     # Fixed future worker infrastructure may take this controller record once.
452:     # It is not an IPC witness, child-local lease or permission to construct.
453:     _require(type(session) is OwnedSession, "Exact session required to consume controller startup")
454:     _require(type(startup) is _ControllerASRStart, "Issued controller startup required")
455:     custody = _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.get(id(startup))
456:     _require(type(custody) is _StartupCustody and custody.startup is startup,
457:              "Copied controller startup has no issuance authority")
458:     with custody.manager._lock:
459:         with custody.token._lock:
460:             _validate_startup_locked(custody, startup, permit, session)
461:             _require(custody.consumed_by is None, "Controller startup was already consumed")
462:             custody.consumed_by = session
463:     return startup
464: 
465: 
466: def _fixed_real_worker_start(startup, permit, session):
467:     _validate_controller_startup(startup, permit, session)
468:     raise AdapterUnavailable("Authenticated child transport, runtime state and fixed real bootstrap are unavailable")

471: @contextmanager
472: def _controller_startup_scope(choice, caller_root, *, usage, root_kind):
473:     """Retain accepted controller input before the still-closed worker seam.
474: 
475:     No acquisition, worker start or model constructor is called here. Once a
476:     native permit is reserved, an unfinished scope remains quarantined under
477:     the existing exception-aware lifecycle; it never invents no-worker cleanup.
478:     """
479:     configured = _startup_configuration()
480:     authority, trusted, selected, store, snapshot = _STARTUP_RELEASE(choice, caller_root, root_kind=root_kind)
481:     _require(authority is configured, "Startup release changed during selection")
482:     profile = _STARTUP_PROFILE(authority, usage)
483:     manager, factory = SNAPSHOT_LIFECYCLE, RUNTIME_FACTORY
484:     _require(type(manager) is DurableSnapshotLifecycle and type(factory) is DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory
485:              and factory.manager is manager, "Exact durable startup lifecycle and factory required")
486:     custody = _StartupCustody(authority, trusted, selected, profile, usage, manager, factory)
487:     # Custody starts before any lease/admission/binding operation can fail.
488:     _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS[id(custody)] = custody
489:     try:
490:         # Retain the lease wrapper before entry can reserve protection.
491:         custody.lease = manager.read_lease(str(store), choice, selected.revision)
492:         _require(type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease and custody.lease.manager is manager,
493:                  "Exact issued durable lease required")
494:         _startup_selection_current(custody)
495:         with custody.lease:
496:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
497:             custody.admission = _STARTUP_ADMIT(trusted, choice, store, snapshot)
498:             admitted = custody.admission
499:             _require(type(admitted) is resolver.Admission and type(admitted.manifest) is resolver.TrustedManifest
500:                      and admitted.manifest == trusted and admitted.manifest.approval is authority.manifest_approval
501:                      and admitted.choice == choice and admitted.snapshot == str(snapshot)
502:                      and admitted.private_root == str(store), "Exact successful selected admission required")
503:             # Admission reparses the manifest; retain its exact selected object,
504:             # while retaining the initial approved manifest separately.
505:             custody.selected = next(model for model in admitted.manifest.models if model.choice == choice)
506:             _require(custody.selected == selected, "Admission selected a different model")
507:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
508:             custody.permit = custody.lease.begin_native_session()
509:             custody.record = custody.permit.record
510:             custody.key = custody.record.key
511:             custody.protection = custody.record.protection
512:             custody.token = custody.lease.token
513:             _startup_selection_current(custody)
514:             custody.binding = _STARTUP_BIND(admitted)
515:             b = custody.binding
516:             _require(type(b) is resolver.LocalBinding and b.choice == choice
517:                      and b.revision == custody.selected.revision
518:                      and b.manifest_sha256 == authority.manifest_approval.manifest_sha256
519:                      and b.model_path == admitted.snapshot and b.files == admitted.files
520:                      and b.local_files_only is True and b.constructor_called is False
521:                      and b.real_runtime_approved is False, "Exact rechecked local startup binding required")
522:             startup = _ControllerASRStart(authority, authority.manifest_approval, trusted,
523:                 admitted, custody.selected, profile, usage, b, custody.permit)
524:             custody.startup = startup
525:             custody.references, custody.values = _startup_references(custody), _startup_values(custody)
526:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS[id(startup)] = custody
527:             _validate_controller_startup(startup, custody.permit)
528:             try:
529:                 yield startup
530:             finally:
531:                 with manager._lock:
532:                     custody.active = False
533:     except BaseException as original:
534:         custody.primary_error = original
535:         raise
536:     finally:
537:         custody.active = False
538:         # A failed/reserved attempt remains retained. It is never converted to
539:         # completion by removing Python references or by a recorded digest.
540:         record = custody.lease.inner._record if type(custody.lease) is _DurableLease else None
541:         if record is not None and record.phase is Phase.RELEASED:
542:             _CONTROLLER_STARTUP_ATTEMPTS.pop(id(custody), None)
543:             if custody.startup is not None:
544:                 _CONTROLLER_STARTUPS.pop(id(custody.startup), None)

547: # Local post-resume lifecycle checks only. No native/pipe/namespace authority.
durable 462: class DurableOwnedRuntimeFactory:
durable 463:     def __init__(self, lifecycle):
durable 464:         if type(lifecycle) is not DurableSnapshotLifecycle:
durable 465:             raise LifecycleUnavailable("Exact durable lifecycle required")
durable 466:         self.manager = lifecycle
durable 467: 
durable 468:     def open_owned_session(self, profile, permit):
durable 469:         manager = self.manager
durable 470:         if type(permit) is not _NativePermit or permit.manager is not manager:
durable 471:             raise LifecycleUnavailable("The active lease's native permit is required")
durable 472:         with manager._lock:
durable 473:             record = permit.record
durable 474:             if (manager._records.get(record.key) is not record or record.permit is not permit.identity
durable 475:                     or record.phase is not Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED or record.owner is not None):
durable 476:                 raise SessionClosed("Native permit is stale or already consumed")
durable 477:             owner = OwnedSession(manager, record)
durable 478:             record.owner = owner
durable 479:         worker = None
durable 480:         try:
durable 481:             # Pending start remains NATIVE_RESERVED with its owner set. Other
durable 482:             # entrants cannot start it; lease exit can revoke without waiting
durable 483:             # for the journal flush or suspended-process preparation.
durable 484:             worker = manager._kernel.start_owned_worker(record.protection, permit.identity, profile)
durable 485:             with manager._lock:
durable 486:                 if record.phase is not Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED or owner._revoked:
durable 487:                     raise SessionClosed("Worker start was revoked before publication")
durable 488:                 owner._worker = worker
durable 489:                 record.phase = Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING
durable 490:                 return owner
durable 491:         except BaseException as original:
durable 492:             if worker is not None:
durable 493:                 # A resumed worker may lose publication to lease revocation.
durable 494:                 # owner._worker is still None here; retain/use this exact owner.
durable 495:                 manager._kernel.stop_unpublished(worker, permit.identity, original)
durable 496:             with manager._lock:
durable 497:                 manager._quarantine_preserving(record, "Owned worker start did not complete", original)
durable 498:             manager._flush_quarantine(record.key, original)
durable 499:             raise

durable 502: class _DurableKernel:
durable 503:     def __init__(self, manager):
durable 504:         self.manager = manager
durable 505:         self._starts = {}
durable 506:         self._pending_quarantine = {}
durable 507: 
durable 508:     def acquire_read(self, key):
durable 509:         self.manager._token(key)
durable 510:         return self.manager._delegate.acquire_read(key)
durable 511: 
durable 512:     def _record(self, protection, permit):
durable 513:         with self.manager._lock:
durable 514:             matches = [r for r in self.manager._records.values()
durable 515:                        if r.protection is protection and r.permit is permit and r.owner is not None]
durable 516:             if len(matches) != 1:
durable 517:                 raise LifecycleUnavailable("Exact current owned record required")
durable 518:             return matches[0]
durable 519: 
durable 520:     def start_owned_worker(self, protection, permit, profile):
durable 521:         manager = self.manager
durable 522:         record = self._record(protection, permit)
durable 523:         token = manager._token(record.key)
durable 524:         worker = None
durable 525:         try:
durable 526:             worker = manager._delegate.create_suspended(protection, permit, profile)
durable 527:             if worker is None:
durable 528:                 raise LifecycleUnavailable("Suspended worker was not returned")
durable 529:             self._starts[permit] = worker
durable 530:             manager._reservations.bind_worker(token, worker)
durable 531:             # Shared lock order is manager state, then reservation state. The
durable 532:             # fixed resume callback must be nonblocking; no file I/O here.
durable 533:             with manager._lock:
durable 534:                 if record.phase is not Phase.NATIVE_RESERVED or record.owner._revoked:
durable 535:                     raise SessionClosed("Start revoked before resume")
durable 536:                 manager._reservations.resume_owned(token, manager._delegate.resume)
durable 537:             # Pipe bootstrap, adoption and policy acknowledgement may block.
durable 538:             # They complete outside both manager and reservation state locks.
durable 539:             if manager._delegate.finish_start(worker, permit, profile) is not True:
durable 540:                 raise LifecycleUnavailable("Owned startup completion unconfirmed")
durable 541:             return worker
durable 542:         except BaseException as original:
durable 543:             try:
durable 544:                 manager._reservations.revoke_local(token)
durable 545:             except BaseException as revoke_error:
durable 546:                 original.add_note("Local revocation raised: " + type(revoke_error).__name__)
durable 547:             if worker is not None:
durable 548:                 self.stop_unpublished(worker, permit, original)
durable 549:             raise
durable 550: 
durable 551:     def stop_unpublished(self, worker, permit, original):
durable 552:         """Retained identity, not PID data or owner publication, authorizes stop."""
durable 553:         try:
durable 554:             if worker is None or self._starts.get(permit) is not worker:
durable 555:                 raise LifecycleUnavailable("Exact retained unpublished worker required")
durable 556:             if self.manager._delegate.stop_start_failure(worker) is not True:
durable 557:                 original.add_note("Exact worker stop remains unconfirmed")
durable 558:         except BaseException as stop_error:
durable 559:             original.add_note("Exact worker stop raised: " + type(stop_error).__name__)
